_meta.description: Append-only log lines emitted by workflow/tile_worker.py.
notes: Separate from tile-workflow, which holds current state per tile. This index is an event log: one document per thing that happened, never updated.
message is text with a keyword subfield, so it is readable in a saved search and still aggregatable when you want to count identical lines.
error_type is the stable machine-readable code. message is the human sentence, which may embed a path or a number and so makes a poor aggregation key.
